text: 美国股指期货周三走势平淡，油价日内反弹1%，现货黄金跌破4300。 大空头Burry加码做空美光、Nebius，逻辑是“内存供应激增，价格将面临下行压力”。 全球最大数据中心融资遇阻，软银旗下SB Energy IPO延期，500亿美元估值遭质疑。 软银启动逾110亿美元的高收益债发行，为AI领域扩张筹资。 量子计算公司IonQ盘前大涨12%，公司展示业界首个端到端实时量子纠错解码器。 阿里云未来一年将在8个国家和地区新增数据中心。 小米18 Pro系列正式发布：5999元起售。 日股今日休市，沪指收跌0.39%，恒指收跌1.01%。
text_en: US stock index futures were flat on Wednesday, oil prices rebounded 1% during the day, and spot gold fell below 4,300. Big short Michael Burry increased his short bets against Micron and Nebius, based on the logic that "memory supply is surging, and prices will face downward pressure." The world's largest data center financing encountered obstacles, SoftBank's SB Energy IPO was postponed, and its $50 billion valuation was questioned. SoftBank launched a high-yield bond issuance of more than $11 billion to raise funds for AI expansion. Quantum computing company IonQ surged 12% premarket after the company demonstrated the industry's first end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder. Alibaba Cloud will add data centers in 8 countries and regions over the next year. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series was officially released: starting at 5,999 yuan. Japanese stocks were closed today, the Shanghai Composite Index closed down 0.39%, and the Hang Seng Index closed down 1.01%.
